== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Imperial Supply (Japanese)|Imperial Supply]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/showcase/miscellaneous/1998-decipher-star-wars-ccg-japanese-hoth-robert-john/imagegallery/32924 Robert John's Japanese Hoth PSA showcase], [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/152940014/c3CV5BroWkqFA4oSWragsA.jpg source photograph], PSA certificate 86099789.

Crop rectangle <code>(145, 620, 1290, 2220)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>cd6fd11654ef57b9613ba58576c14aa8acdd73dd8dac23981a83fc362c5dd301</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
